Testing samples to look at how covariatew confound with PD


```{r}
library(ggplot2) # for plotting

library(patchwork)  # Combine multiple figures

# OUTPUT DIRECTORY
pd_out_dir <- "/scratch/prj/bcn_marzi_lab/analysis_cutandtag_pd_sc/student_data_package/jd_analysis_sc/saved_objects/new_sc_mofa_clean_14042026/pd_association"
dir.create(pd_out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

```
Add metadata - age boxplot
shows age differs between PD and control sample
```{r}
p_age <- ggplot(sample_meta_full,
                aes(x = condition, y = age, fill = condition)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, size = 2.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Control" = "#0072B2",
                               "PD"      = "#E69F00")) +
  labs(title    = "Age at death",
       subtitle = "Correlated with PD — excluded as covariate",
       x        = "",
       y        = "Age (years)") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        plot.subtitle   = element_text(size = 8, colour = "grey40"),
        plot.title      = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"))
```

PMI 

```{r}
p_pmi <- ggplot(sample_meta_full,
                aes(x = condition, y = pmi, fill = condition)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, size = 2.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Control" = "#0072B2",
                               "PD"      = "#E69F00")) +
  labs(title    = "Post-mortem interval",
       subtitle = "Differs between groups — excluded as covariate",
       x        = "",
       y        = "PMI (hours)") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        plot.subtitle   = element_text(size = 8, colour = "grey40"),
        plot.title      = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"))
```

Sex stacked barchart to show differnce between PD and Control


```{r}
p_sex <- ggplot(sample_meta_full,
                aes(x = condition, fill = sex)) +
  # STACKED BAR - position fill makes bars proportional (0-100%)
  geom_bar(position = "fill", alpha = 0.8) +
  # COLOURS - blue for male, pink for female (Okabe-Ito)
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("M" = "#56B4E9",
                               "F" = "#CC79A7"),
                    name   = "Sex") +
  # CONVERT Y AXIS TO PERCENTAGE
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(title    = "Sex distribution",
       subtitle = "Balanced between groups — retained as covariate",
       x        = "",
       y        = "Proportion") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8, colour = "grey40"),
        plot.title    = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"))
```

Combine into a single plot
```{r}

p_combined <- p_age + p_pmi + p_sex +
  plot_layout(ncol = 3) +
  plot_annotation(
    title   = "Justification for covariate selection",
    caption = "Okabe-Ito colour-blind-friendly palette | n = 9 donors",
    theme   = theme(
      plot.title   = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, colour = "grey40")
    )
  )
```

```{r}
ggsave(
  file.path(pd_out_dir, "covariate_justification.pdf"),
  plot   = p_combined,
  width  = 10,
  height = 4.5,
  bg     = "white"
)

cat("Saved to:", file.path(pd_out_dir, "covariate_justification.png"), "\n")
```
